latest.title: Z-Deck 0.2.59-cyberdeck

preUpdateBackup.reason: A/B app-only OTA does not write NVS, LittleFS, or SD; manual SD backup remains available as a separate queued action.

latest.notes: Adds a dedicated Bluetooth app with radio, connection, pairing, and device status plus guarded on-device controls. Fixes Bluetooth-enabled normal boot incorrectly entering USB programming mode. App-only A/B OTA never overwrites MeshCore, NVS, LittleFS, SD files, channels, keys, or local preferences.
